chapters.label: Live: the 2025 final
chapters.text: Champions League final, 2025, in France. Palma, in green, play Kairat. Early on, the pivot Jesús Gordillo fires Palma in front! The green corner of fans goes wild. Palma win nine four, a third title in a row!

chapters.label: How he does it (demo)
chapters.text: Watch how he does it. The winger drives down the side. Gordillo pins his defender, then slips to the back post. The pass comes across, and he hits it first time. Goal!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Be ready at the back post, and finish first time, with no extra touch!
